Noto Sans JP is identified as a Noto Project font and is distributed under the
SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.

The canonical license text is maintained by the upstream Google Fonts package:

https://github.com/google/fonts/raw/main/ofl/notosansjp/OFL.txt

This notice is kept with the repository inventory so release packaging can
include the required attribution and the exact upstream license reference.
The checked-in binary's exact upstream revision has not been hash-matched;
see `third_party/assets.json` before treating this notice as proof of a
particular upstream build.
